public_rationale: The claim is about one 10-minute ChatGPT session on 4 February 2025. The only primary record is the conversation Marcus shared, and I could not find it: the post's text has no link URLs and searches did not turn it up. The speaker's own post cannot count as proof. A critic, Benjamin Todd, wrote that GPT-4o "misses out a bunch of states", but he does not clearly say he checked Marcus's transcript. A reader's separate GPT-4o run also left out states. Both make the claim plausible. Neither shows how many of Marcus's own tables had the wrong count.
limitations: Could not get the primary transcript.
The supporting context comes from a critic's restatement and a reader comment, not from an independent check of the session.
